description: This file defines the RippleHandler class, which manages WebSocket connections to a Ripple service, including initialization, termination, and sending intent messages.

classes.name: RippleHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing WebSocket communication with Ripple, including session management and intent messaging.

methods.name: RippleHandler::RippleHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RippleHandler instance.

methods.name: RippleHandler::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RippleHandler with an event handler and sets up WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: RippleHandler::terminate
methods.description: Terminates the WebSocket connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: RippleHandler::sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent message to the Ripple service, establishing a connection if necessary.
